name: Biblios
summary: Medieval abbots draft and auction cards to win majority in five book categories for variable Victory Points.
rules_text: 2-4 players have a 87-card deck of 5 colors (categories) with values and letters, Gold, Church. Dice on 5 categories start at 3 VP. Setup: discard cards per player count, shuffle remainder. Gift Phase: active player draws N cards one at a time (5 for 4p, 4 for 3p, 3 for 2p). Must place exactly 1 face-down to self, 1 face-down to Auction pile, rest face-up to public. Then self takes own card, others in order take one public card to hand. Next player active. Repeat until draw pile empty. Auction Phase: shuffle Auction pile. Active player reveals top card. Left player starts bidding with Gold amount or pass, clockwise, must raise. If all pass card discarded. Winner pays by discarding Gold cards meeting bid (may overpay) and takes card. If cannot pay, others steal random card from them and card re-auctioned without them. Church cards adjust dice values. End: sum values per color; highest total wins that category's current die VP; tie broken by earliest letter A-Z. Most VP wins.
rating_reason: Auction drafting monastery library, hidden info and bidding fits
